summary: Iter32: Backend regression for P2P + Card + Live = 37/37 PASS (pytest). All 3 new route modules work end-to-end including the full live-stream lifecycle (create→start→join→pin→react→leave→end, with host/non-host authorization checks), P2P validation matrix (self-send/unknown/amount bounds/reserved/taken), and Card application flow (consent/shipping/duplicate/instant-virtual-DEMO). Regression suite (login cookie, /api/auctions, /api/food/restaurants, /api/payments auth gate) also green. Frontend smoke was PARTIAL: public /live page renders with data-testid='live-page' and correct empty state; BUT first-visit onboarding welcome modal ('Willkommen bei BidBlitz!' with Weiter/Überspringen buttons) blocks the login screen on fresh session, so authenticated /more tile verification + /p2p + /card authed views could not be exercised in this pass. Also observed a PAGEERROR 'Heart is not defined' on first mount — same class of bug as iter30/iter31 missing-lucide-import (NOT in LivePage.jsx, Heart IS imported there; suspect one of the many components grepped with Heart-usage but no import).

ui_bugs.issue: PAGEERROR captured: 'Heart is not defined'. LivePage.jsx DOES import Heart correctly (line 3). Grep across /app/frontend/src for files that reference Heart without importing it returned 10 suspects: KidsQuickModals.jsx, QuickAccessBar.jsx, SendMoneyModal.jsx, AllServicesPage.jsx, RestaurantReservationPage.jsx, ScannerPage.jsx, HotelBookingPage.jsx, MerchantTerminalPage.jsx, NearbyPage.jsx, KidsPremiumHubPage.jsx. Main agent: run `eslint --rule no-undef:error src/**/*.jsx` to pinpoint. This is the FOURTH iteration with missing-lucide-import — please gate PRs with ESLint no-undef as previously recommended.

On fresh (logged-out) session, the '👋 Willkommen bei BidBlitz!' onboarding overlay renders on top of /login (z-[200]) covering the email/password fields. Users (and Playwright) cannot reach the login form until they tap 'Überspringen'. Expected behaviour on the /login route is either to (a) NOT show onboarding until after first login, or (b) keep onboarding scoped to authenticated first-run only. Currently blocks tests and may confuse real users.

action_items: HIGH: Fix 'Heart is not defined' PAGEERROR — run `npx eslint --rule no-undef:error src/` across frontend to identify which of the 10 Heart-referencing files is missing the lucide-react import. This is the 4th iteration in a row with a missing-lucide-import bug; please wire up an ESLint CI gate as suggested in iter31 notes.

MEDIUM: Gate the '👋 Willkommen bei BidBlitz!' onboarding modal behind an authenticated-first-run flag so it does NOT render on /login. Currently it blocks the login form on fresh sessions (tested with mobile viewport 390×844).
LOW: Consider adding data-testid='skip-onboarding-btn' and 'next-onboarding-btn' to the welcome modal so automated tests can dismiss it deterministically if gating is not feasible.

INFO: Kunde's smoke-test data (handle @ahmet, virtual_free card issued, one live stream) persists in DB — tests are idempotent (accept 409 on duplicate apply; tests create new live streams each run). If DB cleanup is desired, add a teardown fixture.
critical_code_review_comments: Same pattern as iter28/30/31: extracted/new components ship with missing lucide-react imports. Must-have: `eslint-plugin-react/jsx-no-undef` or `no-undef` in CI before merge. Four iterations is a streak.
P2P route uses pydantic's Field(..., gt=0, le=5000) which correctly returns 422 on out-of-range amounts — good defensive pydantic usage.
Card route correctly flags is_demo=true on every issued virtual card — good forward-compat with real BaFin issuer.
Live route correctly separates host-only actions (start/end/pin) with 403 on non-host, and masks room_key for non-hosts on GET — good security posture.

Minor: /api/live/join increments viewer_count but uses $max on peak_viewers with the PRE-read value (s.get('viewer_count',0)+1). If two joins race, peak could be off by one (non-critical for analytics). Consider an aggregation pipeline update or post-inc comparison.

Minor: /api/live/leave does NOT require the user to have previously joined — any authenticated user can trigger viewer_count-- if >0. Could be abused to make a stream look unpopular. Consider checking viewer_ids contains the user before decrementing.

context_for_next_testing_agent: (1) Backend suite is green and idempotent — rerun with `pytest backend/tests/test_p2p_card_live.py -v`. (2) To test frontend authed views: first dismiss the onboarding overlay by clicking the 'Überspringen' button OR set localStorage flag (check OnboardingWelcome/ExtraFeatures component for the key it reads). (3) The 'Heart is not defined' PAGEERROR reproduces on any page that imports the offending component — check the grep suspects list above. (4) Auth is COOKIE-based (access_token httpOnly cookie), NOT Bearer token — use requests.Session() not Authorization header.
rca_of_the_issue: Heart PAGEERROR: A component referenced in the /login or shared shell imports `<Heart>` from lucide-react without adding it to the import list. Same RCA as iter30 (Gavel/Clock/TrendingUp/Wallet missing) and iter31 (Package missing) — lazy-loaded or shared shell components are extracted without sweeping for ALL lucide-react usages. Long-term fix (recommended for the 4th time): enable ESLint no-undef in CI. Onboarding modal blocker: the welcome modal (ExtraFeatures component, div with z-[200]) mounts on every visit regardless of auth state — main agent should gate it on (user && !user.onboarding_completed) rather than unconditionally.
